back: A written plan describing an idea, its market, operation and finances, to show it is viable and to ask for support.
Executive summary, problem, solution, market, operations, staffing, finance and risks.
One-off costs before or when a business opens: equipment, stock, registration and launch advertising.
Profit = revenue − total costs for the month.
Payback period = start-up cost ÷ profit per month.
Change an assumption, such as fewer customers, and recalculate profit and payback; list risks with ways to reduce them.
Problem, solution, market, numbers, risks, then what you are asking for; be ready to defend each assumption.
